reviews.title: Great low profile cooler
reviews.comment: Great low profile for price. It’s a Snowman cooler (Brand name popular on Aliexpress). Only issue is the fan. I replaced mine and cools great and quiet The original fan works okay but on the loud side and cooling not so great. Just swap it out. But overall can’t beat the price for what it does
reviews.author: James Brink

reviews.title: Temps dropped 18C under load -5 stars!
reviews.comment: This thing kicks @ss!  The thermalright 120 low profile equivalent is the same price and you get 8 heatpipes with this vs 6 on the thermalright.  it is a little taller than the thermalright, but I made it fit in my MITX case by not securing a fan, I mounted the fan on the door of the case directly over the CPU cooler and it cleared fine and works great!  Using the new 2K rpm skythe slim wonder tornado fan with it and cpu temps went from 65C under load to 47C using prime95 torture test and Superpi 32M runs.  It Idles around 35c  - I5 13400  - best $30 ever spent!  I have several golden cups on HWbot.org on extremecooling and have been extremeoverclocking since 2001. If you do not know what Winbond bh5 is then disregard.
reviews.author: DR. WANKENSTEIN

reviews.title: Not so great, just avoid.
reviews.comment: Cools worse then the Big Shuriken 3 i was trying to replace. was 87C before now even after remounting a half dozen times its still 100C on a 14600k undervolted and power limited to 150w
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.title: Perfect for Acer Aspire TC 1785!!!!
reviews.comment: Perfect little cooler for Acer Aspire TC-1785! The Intel i5 1440 stays at 55c to 60c @ 100% usage and Idles around 35c to 38c. not bad at all than the stock baby cooler that it came with. Overall great price and Happy customer!!!
reviews.author: Jesse Lopez

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.comment: This cooler works great only downside is the fan has a low h20 rating but that doesn’t mean you can’t swap out the fan for like an arctic p12 max. Once you do that, this thing performs almost as good as an aio ! I use a 7800X3D on games like cyberpunk, forza horizon 5, black ops 6 and F1 with temps hitting under 70c average. As long as you swap the fan for something with an h20 rating of 2.0 or higher you’ll be smooth sailing with thing puppy.
reviews.author: budget gamer
